ubr_branch_scoped_unique.name: ubr_branch_scoped_unique

survey_participations_branch_business_ch.name: survey_participations_branch_business_check
survey_participations_branch_business_ch.value: "survey_participations"."branch_id" IS NULL OR "survey_participations"."business_id" IS NOT NULL

surveys_owner_business_check.name: surveys_owner_business_check
surveys_owner_business_check.value: ("surveys"."owner_type" = 'platform' AND "surveys"."business_id" IS NULL) OR ("surveys"."owner_type" = 'business' AND "surveys"."business_id" IS NOT NULL)

community_point_award_decisions_awarded_.name: community_point_award_decisions_awarded_account_check
community_point_award_decisions_awarded_.value: "community_point_award_decisions"."status" NOT IN ('awarded','reversed') OR "community_point_award_decisions"."account_id" IS NOT NULL

community_point_rules_resource_version_k.name: community_point_rules_resource_version_key
community_point_rules_resource_version_k.where: "community_point_rules"."resource_type" IS NOT NULL AND "community_point_rules"."resource_id" IS NOT NULL

community_point_rules_window_check.name: community_point_rules_window_check
community_point_rules_window_check.value: "community_point_rules"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "community_point_rules"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "community_point_rules"."ends_at" > "community_point_rules"."starts_at"

community_point_transactions_sign_check.name: community_point_transactions_sign_check
community_point_transactions_sign_check.value:
("community_point_transactions"."type" = 'earn' AND "community_point_transactions"."points" > 0)
        OR ("community_point_transactions"."type" IN ('redeem','reverse','expire') AND "community_point_transactions"."points" < 0)
        OR ("community_point_transactions"."type" = 'admin_adjustment' AND "community_point_transactions"."points" <> 0)

community_point_transactions_reversal_ch.name: community_point_transactions_reversal_check
community_point_transactions_reversal_ch.value:
("community_point_transactions"."type" = 'reverse' AND "community_point_transactions"."reversal_of" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("community_point_transactions"."type" <> 'reverse' AND "community_point_transactions"."reversal_of" IS NULL)

community_point_transactions_branch_busi.name: community_point_transactions_branch_business_check
community_point_transactions_branch_busi.value: "community_point_transactions"."branch_id" IS NULL OR "community_point_transactions"."business_id" IS NOT NULL

orphan_settlement_events_branch_business.name: orphan_settlement_events_branch_business_check
orphan_settlement_events_branch_business.value: "orphan_settlement_events"."receiving_branch_id" IS NULL OR "orphan_settlement_events"."receiving_business_id" IS NOT NULL

orphan_settlements_acceptance_check.name: orphan_settlements_acceptance_check
orphan_settlements_acceptance_check.value:
"orphan_settlements"."status" NOT IN ('accepted','reserved','completion_authorized','fulfilled')
        OR ("orphan_settlements"."accepted_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "orphan_settlements"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL)

orphan_settlements_completion_authorizat.name: orphan_settlements_completion_authorization_check
orphan_settlements_completion_authorizat.value:
"orphan_settlements"."status" NOT IN ('completion_authorized','fulfilled')
        OR ("orphan_settlements"."completion_authorization_id" IS NOT NULL AND "orphan_settlements"."completion_authorized_at" IS NOT NULL)

orphan_settlements_fulfillment_check.name: orphan_settlements_fulfillment_check
orphan_settlements_fulfillment_check.value:
"orphan_settlements"."status" <> 'fulfilled'
        OR ("orphan_settlements"."fulfilled_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "orphan_settlements"."fulfilled_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "orphan_settlements"."fulfillment_policy_version" IS NOT NULL
          AND "orphan_settlements"."fulfillment_snapshot" IS NOT NULL)

loyalty_rewards_limit_period_days_requir.name: loyalty_rewards_limit_period_days_required_check
loyalty_rewards_limit_period_days_requir.value: "loyalty_rewards"."limit_per" IS NULL OR "loyalty_rewards"."limit_per" != 'period' OR "loyalty_rewards"."limit_period_days" IS NOT NULL

loyalty_rewards_expiry_after_start_check.name: loyalty_rewards_expiry_after_start_check
loyalty_rewards_expiry_after_start_check.value: "loyalty_rewards"."expiry_date" IS NULL OR "loyalty_rewards"."start_date" IS NULL OR "loyalty_rewards"."expiry_date" > "loyalty_rewards"."start_date"

team_invitations_pending_branch_scope_ke.name: team_invitations_pending_branch_scope_key
team_invitations_pending_branch_scope_ke.where: "team_invitations"."branch_id" IS NOT NULL AND "team_invitations"."accepted_at" IS NULL AND "team_invitations"."cancelled_at" IS NULL

team_invitations_pending_business_scope_.name: team_invitations_pending_business_scope_key
team_invitations_pending_business_scope_.where: "team_invitations"."branch_id" IS NULL AND "team_invitations"."accepted_at" IS NULL AND "team_invitations"."cancelled_at" IS NULL

partner_credit_reservations_terminal_con.name: partner_credit_reservations_terminal_consistency
partner_credit_reservations_terminal_con.value: ("partner_credit_reservations"."state" = 'reserved' AND "partner_credit_reservations"."terminal_at" IS NULL) OR ("partner_credit_reservations"."state" IN ('released','consumed') AND "partner_credit_reservations"."terminal_at" IS NOT NULL)

stripe_tier_observation_period_order.name: stripe_tier_observation_period_order
stripe_tier_observation_period_order.value: "stripe_subscription_tier_observations"."item_period_start" IS NULL OR "stripe_subscription_tier_observations"."item_period_end" IS NULL OR "stripe_subscription_tier_observations"."item_period_end" > "stripe_subscription_tier_observations"."item_period_start"

stripe_evidence_control_stream_dedupe_re.name: stripe_evidence_control_stream_dedupe_required
stripe_evidence_control_stream_dedupe_re.value: "stripe_evidence_control_events"."event_kind" NOT IN ('capture_heartbeat','heartbeat_gap_detected','capture_precondition_failed','capture_error_observed','oversize_rejected','ucw_opened','ucw_closed') OR ("stripe_evidence_control_events"."stream" IS NOT NULL AND "stripe_evidence_control_events"."dedupe_key" IS NOT NULL)

stripe_evidence_control_kek_destroyed_cl.name: stripe_evidence_control_kek_destroyed_claim
stripe_evidence_control_kek_destroyed_cl.value: "stripe_evidence_control_events"."event_kind" <> 'kek_destroyed' OR COALESCE(("stripe_evidence_control_events"."details"->>'claim' = 'conditional') OR ("stripe_evidence_control_events"."details"->>'claim' = 'irrecoverable_verified' AND jsonb_typeof("stripe_evidence_control_events"."details"->'evidence') = 'object' AND "stripe_evidence_control_events"."details"->'evidence'->>'e1_custody_inventory' = 'true' AND "stripe_evidence_control_events"."details"->'evidence'->>'e2_two_person_attestation' = 'true' AND "stripe_evidence_control_events"."details"->'evidence'->>'e3_platform_evidence' = 'true' AND "stripe_evidence_control_events"."details"->'evidence'->>'e4_independent_signoff' = 'true' AND "stripe_evidence_control_events"."details"->'evidence'->>'e5_negative_tests_run' = 'true' AND jsonb_typeof("stripe_evidence_control_events"."details"->'evidence_refs') = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length("stripe_evidence_control_events"."details"->'evidence_refs') > 0), false)

stripe_provider_event_conflicts_provenan.name: stripe_provider_event_conflicts_provenance_groups_check
stripe_provider_event_conflicts_provenan.value: ("stripe_provider_event_conflicts"."conflicting_provenance" = 'webhook_signature' AND "stripe_provider_event_conflicts"."sig_header_timestamp" IS NOT NULL AND "stripe_provider_event_conflicts"."sig_scheme" = 'v1' AND "stripe_provider_event_conflicts"."signing_secret_label" IS NOT NULL AND "stripe_provider_event_conflicts"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "stripe_provider_event_conflicts"."verifier_version" IS NOT NULL AND "stripe_provider_event_conflicts"."retrieved_at" IS NULL AND "stripe_provider_event_conflicts"."retrieval_run_id" IS NULL AND "stripe_provider_event_conflicts"."retrieval_api_version" IS NULL) OR ("stripe_provider_event_conflicts"."conflicting_provenance" = 'api_retrieval' AND "stripe_provider_event_conflicts"."retrieved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "stripe_provider_event_conflicts"."retrieval_run_id" IS NOT NULL AND "stripe_provider_event_conflicts"."retrieval_api_version" IS NOT NULL AND "stripe_provider_event_conflicts"."sig_header_timestamp" IS NULL AND "stripe_provider_event_conflicts"."sig_scheme" IS NULL AND "stripe_provider_event_conflicts"."signing_secret_label" IS NULL AND "stripe_provider_event_conflicts"."verified_at" IS NULL AND "stripe_provider_event_conflicts"."verifier_version" IS NULL)

stripe_provider_event_dispositions_claim.name: stripe_provider_event_dispositions_claim_fields_check
stripe_provider_event_dispositions_claim.value: "stripe_provider_event_dispositions"."disposition" <> 'processing_claimed' OR ("stripe_provider_event_dispositions"."attempt_no" IS NOT NULL AND "stripe_provider_event_dispositions"."claimant" IS NOT NULL AND "stripe_provider_event_dispositions"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

stripe_provider_events_provenance_groups.name: stripe_provider_events_provenance_groups_check
stripe_provider_events_provenance_groups.value: ("stripe_provider_events"."provenance" = 'webhook_signature' AND "stripe_provider_events"."sig_header_timestamp" IS NOT NULL AND "stripe_provider_events"."sig_scheme" IS NOT NULL AND "stripe_provider_events"."signing_secret_label" IS NOT NULL AND "stripe_provider_events"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "stripe_provider_events"."verifier_version" IS NOT NULL AND "stripe_provider_events"."retrieved_at" IS NULL AND "stripe_provider_events"."retrieval_run_id" IS NULL AND "stripe_provider_events"."retrieval_api_version" IS NULL) OR ("stripe_provider_events"."provenance" = 'api_retrieval' AND "stripe_provider_events"."retrieved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "stripe_provider_events"."retrieval_run_id" IS NOT NULL AND "stripe_provider_events"."retrieval_api_version" IS NOT NULL AND "stripe_provider_events"."sig_header_timestamp" IS NULL AND "stripe_provider_events"."sig_scheme" IS NULL AND "stripe_provider_events"."signing_secret_label" IS NULL AND "stripe_provider_events"."verified_at" IS NULL AND "stripe_provider_events"."verifier_version" IS NULL)

benefit_application_intents_shape_check.name: benefit_application_intents_shape_check
benefit_application_intents_shape_check.value:
(
    ("benefit_application_intents"."state" = 'reserved' AND "benefit_application_intents"."attempt_key" IS NULL AND "benefit_application_intents"."cause" IS NULL AND "benefit_application_intents"."provider_effect_ref" IS NULL AND "benefit_application_intents"."applied_at" IS NULL AND "benefit_application_intents"."outcome" = 'pending')
    OR ("benefit_application_intents"."state" = 'applying' AND "benefit_application_intents"."attempt_key" IS NOT NULL AND "benefit_application_intents"."attempted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "benefit_application_intents"."cause" IS NULL AND "benefit_application_intents"."provider_effect_ref" IS NULL AND "benefit_application_intents"."applied_at" IS NULL AND "benefit_application_intents"."outcome" = 'pending')
    OR ("benefit_application_intents"."state" = 'retained' AND "benefit_application_intents"."attempt_key" IS NOT NULL AND "benefit_application_intents"."attempted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "benefit_application_intents"."cause" IS NOT NULL AND "benefit_application_intents"."provider_effect_ref" IS NULL AND "benefit_application_intents"."applied_at" IS NULL AND "benefit_application_intents"."outcome" IN ('disputed','unresolved'))
    OR ("benefit_application_intents"."state" = 'consumed' AND "benefit_application_intents"."attempt_key" IS NOT NULL AND "benefit_application_intents"."provider_effect_ref" IS NOT NULL AND "benefit_application_intents"."applied_at" IS NOT NULL AND "benefit_application_intents"."cause" IS NULL AND "benefit_application_intents"."outcome" = 'confirmed')
    OR ("benefit_application_intents"."state" = 'released' AND "benefit_application_intents"."cause" IS NOT NULL AND "benefit_application_intents"."provider_effect_ref" IS NULL AND "benefit_application_intents"."applied_at" IS NULL AND "benefit_application_intents"."outcome" = 'rejected'))

benefit_provider_observations_shape_chec.name: benefit_provider_observations_shape_check
benefit_provider_observations_shape_chec.value:
("benefit_provider_observations"."status" = 'effect_present' AND "benefit_provider_observations"."effect_ref" IS NOT NULL AND "benefit_provider_observations"."amount_minor" IS NOT NULL AND "benefit_provider_observations"."amount_minor" >= 0 AND "benefit_provider_observations"."currency" IS NOT NULL AND "benefit_provider_observations"."invoice_ref" IS NOT NULL AND "benefit_provider_observations"."classification" IN ('matched','mismatch','unattributed'))
    OR ("benefit_provider_observations"."status" = 'effect_absent' AND "benefit_provider_observations"."effect_ref" IS NULL AND "benefit_provider_observations"."classification" IN ('absent_confirmed','absent_stale'))
    OR ("benefit_provider_observations"."status" = 'unreachable' AND "benefit_provider_observations"."effect_ref" IS NULL AND "benefit_provider_observations"."classification" = 'unreachable')

benefit_reconciliation_attempts_counts_c.name: benefit_reconciliation_attempts_counts_check
benefit_reconciliation_attempts_counts_c.value: ("benefit_reconciliation_attempts"."lines_inspected" IS NULL OR "benefit_reconciliation_attempts"."lines_inspected" >= 0) AND ("benefit_reconciliation_attempts"."effect_count" IS NULL OR "benefit_reconciliation_attempts"."effect_count" >= 0) AND ("benefit_reconciliation_attempts"."retry_after_ms" IS NULL OR "benefit_reconciliation_attempts"."retry_after_ms" >= 0)

partner_credit_award_disputes_shape_chec.name: partner_credit_award_disputes_shape_check
partner_credit_award_disputes_shape_chec.value:
("partner_credit_award_disputes"."state" = 'open' AND "partner_credit_award_disputes"."resolved_at" IS NULL AND "partner_credit_award_disputes"."plan" IS NULL)
    OR ("partner_credit_award_disputes"."state" = 'released' AND "partner_credit_award_disputes"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "partner_credit_award_disputes"."plan" IS NULL)
    OR ("partner_credit_award_disputes"."state" = 'revoked' AND "partner_credit_award_disputes"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "partner_credit_award_disputes"."plan" IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof("partner_credit_award_disputes"."plan") = 'object')

heta_provenance_comparisons_shape_check.name: heta_provenance_comparisons_shape_check
heta_provenance_comparisons_shape_check.value:
("heta_provenance_comparisons"."disposition" = 'corroborated_fields' AND "heta_provenance_comparisons"."retrieved_record_id" IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_array_length("heta_provenance_comparisons"."mismatches") = 0 AND jsonb_array_length("heta_provenance_comparisons"."reasons") = 0)
    OR ("heta_provenance_comparisons"."disposition" = 'conflicted' AND "heta_provenance_comparisons"."retrieved_record_id" IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_array_length("heta_provenance_comparisons"."mismatches") > 0)
    OR ("heta_provenance_comparisons"."disposition" = 'incomparable' AND "heta_provenance_comparisons"."retrieved_record_id" IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_array_length("heta_provenance_comparisons"."reasons") > 0)
    OR ("heta_provenance_comparisons"."disposition" = 'unassessed' AND "heta_provenance_comparisons"."retrieved_record_id" IS NULL AND jsonb_array_length("heta_provenance_comparisons"."mismatches") = 0)

heta_reconciliation_work_shape_check.name: heta_reconciliation_work_shape_check
heta_reconciliation_work_shape_check.value:
("heta_reconciliation_work"."state" = 'leased') = ("heta_reconciliation_work"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "heta_reconciliation_work"."lease_owner" IS NOT NULL AND "heta_reconciliation_work"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)
    AND (("heta_reconciliation_work"."state" IN ('done','dead')) = ("heta_reconciliation_work"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL))
    AND ("heta_reconciliation_work"."state" <> 'dead' OR "heta_reconciliation_work"."last_error_code" IS NOT NULL)
